audience: New hires, freshers, students, and infrastructure engineers moving into storage operations

modules.title: Storage building blocks
modules.outcome: Differentiate block, file, object, volume, LUN, filesystem, and datastore layers.

modules.title: Performance fundamentals
modules.outcome: Relate IOPS, throughput, latency, block size, concurrency, and queueing.

modules.title: Data protection and recovery
modules.outcome: Choose among RAID, snapshots, replication, erasure coding, and backup using failure and recovery objectives.

modules.title: SAN architecture
modules.outcome: Trace a host-to-LUN path and identify every independent failure domain.

modules.title: Fibre Channel fabric operations
modules.outcome: Explain login, naming, services, ISLs, health signals, and dual-fabric behavior.

modules.title: Zoning and safe change
modules.outcome: Create, validate, activate, roll back, and remove zoning safely.

modules.title: iSCSI and multipathing
modules.outcome: Build and diagnose a redundant iSCSI path from network to session and multipath policy.

modules.title: Operations and incident response
modules.outcome: Run health checks, gather evidence, isolate failure domains, remediate, and hand off safely.

modules.title: Zero-to-SAN practical assessment
modules.outcome: Demonstrate end-to-end inspection, configuration, failure recovery, rollback, and evidence reporting.
